title: Uncovering the signaling networks of disseminated glioblastoma cells in vivo with INSIGHT.
snippet: Dysregulation of intracellular signaling networks underpins cancer. Yet, resolving signaling networks within distinct or rare cell types in cancer in vivo has been unattainable.
